records.statement: Triumph's 2024/2025 TF 250-X owner's handbook lists two engine maps (MAP 1 standard, MAP 2 full power) that also set traction control, switchable traction control, launch control and a quickshifter.

values.map_switch: short press toggles MAP 1 / MAP 2 (switch lit = MAP 2); also changes switch-housing LED brightness
values.maps: MAP 1 = standard engine response and traction control; MAP 2 = full power engine response and traction control
values.traction_control: short press of TC switch turns traction control on/off (LED lit when on); setting is tied to the selected map
values.launch_control: activate stationary, engine idling, in neutral: press and hold LC until LED lights; LED flashes after the start and LC switches off automatically a few seconds into the race; also cancelled by long press or full throttle; clutch used normally
values.quickshifter: short press toggles; works on up-shifts from 2nd gear above 2,500 rpm (not 1st-2nd, not down-shifts); long press resets quickshifter adaption
values.idle_auto_shutoff: engine switches off after seven minutes at idle without throttle input
values.service_hour_counter: non-resettable hour meter behind the front number board
values.ecm_calibration: check for latest ECM calibration with the Triumph diagnostic tool at every service
values.holeshot_device: lever-selected two-piston holeshot clamp: top piston = minimum fork compression, bottom piston = maximum; engage with engine off in neutral

not_found: Triumph valve clearance values: all five handbooks schedule the check (first hour, 45 h, 90 h) but give no clearances; they are in the Triumph service manual (TTI registration required).
Triumph fork oil grade/type, fork oil level in mm, shock oil and shock nitrogen pressure: not in any handbook (fork oil is given by volume only).
Triumph riding-sag figure in the 2027 TF250-X/TF450-X handbook (3850823): procedure only, no value.
Triumph dry/wet weights and seat height: handbooks refer to the dealer or website.

Triumph handbooks print no model year; years taken from the catalog/TTI listing (3850529: 2024-2025, 3850672: 2025-2026, 3850823: 2027, 3850699 and 3850136: 2026). TF450-RC Edition assigned 2025 and TF450-X 2026 within 3850672 per the garage roster.
Triumph TF250-E handbook tire table is headed TF450-E (values assumed shared); TF250-C rear tire printed as 80/100 x 21 and TF450-C trail printed as 0.06 in (116 mm) - misprints kept as printed.

WP owner's manuals: no bike model years; XACT PRO 8950 (18.15.0U.07) lists gas pressure only for the FC 350; XACT PRO 8950 18.18.0T.07, XPLOR PRO 8950 and the fork manuals other than the KX450 kit and XPLOR PRO 6500 (0761C141V002230) list no spring rates.
WP XACT PRO 7543, XACT PRO 7746 and XPLOR PRO 6500 (0761C141V002230) manuals name no bike; recorded under make WP with product numbers only.
WP AER 48 and TRAX PDS 2017 manuals point to a separate Standard Adjustments sheet for numeric air pressures, chrome length and sag; only the TRAX LINK/PDS sheet was in the download set.

KYB 2021 catalog: no fork springs listed for Kawasaki KX450 2013+ (current KX450), Honda CRF250R/CRF250RX or CRF450R 2013+, Yamaha YZ125/YZ250 forks; no shock springs for Honda CRF250R or Kawasaki KX450 2015+. Two-stroke KX125/KX250 rows were not mapped to the garage KX250 (four-stroke).

KYB catalog entries for GasGas EC250/300 and XC250/300 2018-2020, Husqvarna CR/TC/TXC 2010-2013, Beta, Sherco, TM, Rieju and Suzuki were not recorded (outside the requested makes or not garage models).
Catalog entries free103/free104 (CPSC recall pages) were outside this slice and not processed.
